pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Read: Quand il y a un orage, je reste dans la maison. Je ne vais pas sous un grand arbre. Quand il fait très chaud, je bois de l'eau. Question: What does the speaker drink when it is very hot? (1 mark)
   A. juice
   B. water
   C. milk
   D. tea

2. What does 'je chante' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yesterday
   B. I play
   C. today
   D. I sing

3. Which little word goes with 'pied' (the foot)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. la
   D. l'

4. How do you say 'the grandmother' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la famille
   B. la grand-mère
   C. la fille
   D. le frère

5. What does 'Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am ten years old.
   B. How old are you?
   C. Happy birthday!
   D. There is a cake and there are balloons.

6. How do you say 'Saturday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. mercredi
   B. samedi
   C. lundi
   D. dimanche

7. How do you say 'the eyes' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le ventre
   B. le doigt
   C. le bras
   D. les yeux

8. How do you say 'the hand' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le genou
   B. la main
   C. le ventre
   D. l'épaule

9. How do you write the number 4 in French? (1 mark)
   A. douze
   B. vingt
   C. quatre
   D. deux

10. What does 'le canapé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the bag
   B. the bed
   C. the bedroom
   D. the sofa

11. Read: Amina: Excusez-moi, où est l'école ? Kamau: Allez tout droit. Tournez à gauche. Amina: Merci ! Kamau: De rien ! Question: What does Amina want to find? (1 mark)
   A. the house
   B. the shop
   C. the church
   D. the school

12. What does 'Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Put the book on the table.
   B. The cat is under the chair.
   C. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   D. The rug is in front of the sofa.

13. What number is 'neuf' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 9
   D. 21

14. How do you say 'The bag is in the bedroom.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   B. Mets le livre dans la chambre.
   C. Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.
   D. Voici ma maison.

15. What does 'le poulet' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the carrot
   B. chips
   C. chicken
   D. the cake

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into French: 'Goodbye, Sir.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

17. Translate into French: 'On Friday, I dance.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Write the French words for: Put, behind, under (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into English: 'Qui est-ce ?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

21. Translate into French: 'I have two ears.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — water
   Je bois de l'eau.

2. D — I sing
   je chante means I sing.

3. A — le
   pied is masculine, so we say le pied.

4. B — la grand-mère
   the grandmother in French is la grand-mère.

5. D — There is a cake and there are balloons.
   Il y a un gâteau et des ballons. means There is a cake and there are balloons.

6. B — samedi
   Saturday in French is samedi.

7. D — les yeux
   the eyes in French is les yeux.

8. B — la main
   the hand in French is la main.

9. C — quatre
   4 in French is quatre.

10. D — the sofa
   le canapé means the sofa.

11. D — the school
   Où est l'école ?

12. C — In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo. means In the kitchen, there is a fridge.

13. C — 9
   neuf means 9.

14. A — Le sac est dans la chambre.
   The bag is in the bedroom. in French is Le sac est dans la chambre.

15. C — chicken
   le poulet means chicken.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Au revoir, Monsieur.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le vendredi, je danse.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mets, derrière, sous
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Who is it?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: My sister is called Njeri.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: J'ai deux oreilles.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.
